headline.zh: 将课程材料转化为自适应学习工具
headline.en: Turn course material into adaptive study tools

scenario.zh: 你需要帮助学生为期末考试复习遗传学单元
scenario.en: You need to help students review genetics unit for final exam

instruction.zh: 选择要转换为学习材料的课程内容类型
instruction.en: Select the type of course content to convert into study materials

label.en: Upload lecture slides PDF (8 chapters, 42 pages)

output.zh: 已识别82个关键概念，包括等位基因分离、染色体交叉和基因调控
output.en: Identified 82 key concepts including allele segregation, chromosome crossover and gene regulation

output.zh: 已提取54个核心术语和12个遗传学定律及原理
output.en: Extracted 54 core terms and 12 genetic laws and principles

instruction.zh: 根据学生当前掌握情况选择优先领域
instruction.en: Choose priority area based on current student mastery

label.zh: 强化薄弱环节（孟德尔遗传）

output.zh: 生成28张针对性闪卡和6道庞氏图解题，专注于显隐性与分离定律
output.en: Generated 28 targeted flashcards and 6 Punnett square problems focusing on dominance and segregation

output.zh: 创建65张闪卡覆盖全部章节，附带18分钟音频播客总结
output.en: Created 65 flashcards covering all chapters with 18-minute audio podcast summary

instruction.zh: 查看不同学习工具如何适应学生需求
instruction.en: See how different study tools adapt to student needs

label.zh: 自适应测验（跟踪掌握度）

output.zh: 根据答题表现调整难度，重复出现错误概念直到掌握
output.en: Adjusts difficulty based on performance, repeats missed concepts until mastered

output.zh: 安排复习时间表，困难卡片出现频率更高，熟练内容间隔延长
output.en: Schedules review sessions with difficult cards appearing more often, mastered content spaced further

instruction.zh: 选择最终分发给学生的学习材料组合
instruction.en: Select final study material bundle to distribute to students

label.zh: 基础包：闪卡 + 练习题

output.zh: 包含65张闪卡和22道自测题，可在手机或网页访问
output.en: Includes 65 flashcards and 22 self-test questions, accessible on mobile or web

label.zh: 完整包：闪卡 + 测验 + 播客

output.zh: 多模态学习套件含音频讲解、交互式测验和随时随地复习工具
output.en: Multimodal learning suite with audio explanations, interactive quiz and on-the-go review tools

takeaway.zh: 自适应技术根据学生表现自动调整学习路径，专注于需要加强的知识点
takeaway.en: Adaptive technology automatically adjusts learning path based on student performance, focusing on areas needing reinforcement

initial.zh: 遗传学基础：孟德尔定律、DNA结构、基因表达与遗传变异
initial.en: Genetics fundamentals: Mendel's laws, DNA structure, gene expression & variation
